Puccinellia distans in Świerzno, NW Poland
Inland salt-marsh community of Reflexed Saltmarsh-grass ( Puccinellia distans ) and glaswort ( Salicornia europaea ). The area near salt-sodium industry factory. Poland.

Stem with leaf sheath and ligule Taxonym: Puccinellia distans ss Fischer et al. EfÖLS 2008 ISBN 978-3-85474-187-9 Location: quarry and earth dump 2,2 km ESE Laa an der Thaya, district Mistelbach, Lowe

The open panicles with widely divergent branches are characteristic of this Puccinellia, as are the small spikelets about at about 2 mm long or less. Photo by Scott Frazier, Confluence Consulting, Inc
